prompt:

Place the desk low enough to keep her arms readable.

Her OWN RIGHT ARM is on the VIEWER'S LEFT: the right upper arm descends from its clearly visible shoulder beside her torso; the right elbow rests on the desktop; the right forearm rises naturally toward her chest. Her OWN LEFT ARM is on the VIEWER'S RIGHT: it descends from its shoulder, bends naturally at an elbow resting on the desk, and its forearm lies on the tabletop. Her left hand rests relaxed beside a closed ink pot, fingers naturally separated. Exactly one head, two shoulders, two arms, two hands, five digits per hand. No crossed or overlapping arm chains.

Retain her same adult face, same expression, same outfit and its cut, same hair and skin finish. The new pose is the requested change. Medieval room with shelves, folded papers, ink pot, brushes, a candle and a leaded-glass window; no second person, no weapon, no readable writing, no watermark or border. Preserve the reference's Korean game illustration rendering and warm/cool room lighting. Vertical 2:3, 1024x1536.
